title: General Brenner Requests a Meeting
description: General Brenner's office has requested a private meeting in the General Staff Wing — not through the usual channels. The subject is listed as 'matters of institutional concern regarding the constitutional referendum.' He does not use that language carelessly.

title: Constitutional Draft — Emergency Powers Review
description: Brenner's concerns center on the emergency powers provisions. Review the relevant articles with his institutional perspective in mind before the final draft goes to print.

title: Budget Allocation — Military Readiness
description: Brenner's briefing will have budget implications. The military's institutional concerns often translate to resource requests. Be prepared to adjust allocations.

title: Jonas — Final Chance
description: Jonas hasn't mentioned the note. He's stopped asking when you'll be home. The silence is worse than the question.

title: Referendum Day — Logistics Briefing
description: Vyktor has the final polling station deployment, the security arrangements, and the diplomatic observer list. The machinery of democracy is ready. The only thing left is the vote.
